title: Law to warn homeowners at risk of displacement
summary: This bill would require the city's Homeowner Advocate to create an outreach and education program helping homeowners facing displacement learn about available assistance and services. The city would identify community districts facing the highest displacement risk each year, based on factors like eviction and foreclosure rates and property value increases, and target outreach there. Materials on fraud prevention, legal aid, financial assistance and property tax relief would be published online and distributed within 180 days of the law taking effect.
